dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid, near-linear geometric narrowing from the mid-body region toward a sharp posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a minor asymmetrical convex protrusion on the right flank near the mid-section.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters distributed primarily in the anterior and central dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-gradient transitions between the light baseline and darker pigmented areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple high-contrast, linear light-colored marks (rake marks) extending diagonally and longitudinally across the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive network of healed linear rake marks visible across the majority of the dorsal surface.
